installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (2018 Legacy) - Pterodactyl installer
#
# Installs a pinned build straight from Steam depots 731 (game content) and
# 740 (Linux dedicated server binaries) at fixed manifest IDs. app_update is
# never called, so the build cannot drift forward to a newer CS:GO or to CS2.
#
# Egg variables consumed here:
#   DEPOT_731_MANIFEST      manifest ID for depot 731
#   DEPOT_740_MANIFEST      manifest ID for depot 740
#   KEEP_DEPOT_CACHE        keep the SteamCMD staging copy   (true/false)
#   STRIP_BUNDLED_LIBGCC    move bin/libgcc_s.so.1 aside     (true/false)
#   STEAMINF_APPID          rewrite csgo/steam.inf appID ("" = leave alone)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -uo pipefail

MANIFEST_731="${DEPOT_731_MANIFEST:-}"
MANIFEST_740="${DEPOT_740_MANIFEST:-}"
KEEP_CACHE="${KEEP_DEPOT_CACHE:-false}"
STRIP_LIBGCC="${STRIP_BUNDLED_LIBGCC:-true}"
STEAMINF_APPID="${STEAMINF_APPID:-}"

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
STEAMCMD_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.steamcmd"
CONTENT_DIR="${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamapps/content/app_740"

log()  { echo "[csgo2018] $*"; }
fail() { echo "[csgo2018] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

case "${MANIFEST_731}${MANIFEST_740}" in
    *[!0-9]*|'') fail "both depot manifest IDs must be set and numeric" ;;
esac

# --- prerequisites ----------------------------------------------------------
log "installing packages"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get -y update >/dev/null || fail "apt-get update failed"
apt-get -y --no-install-recommends install curl ca-certificates tar file \
    || fail "package installation failed"
# SteamCMD itself is 32-bit, and the runtime package name differs by release.
apt-get -y --no-install-recommends install lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6 \
    || apt-get -y --no-install-recommends install lib32gcc1 lib32stdc++6 \
    || log "WARNING: could not install the 32-bit runtime libs, SteamCMD may fail"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}" "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

# --- SteamCMD ---------------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -x "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh" ]; then
    log "installing SteamCMD into ${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
    curl -sSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" \
        | tar -xzf - -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" || fail "SteamCMD download failed"
    chmod +x "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh"
fi

download_depot() {
    local depot="$1" manifest="$2" attempt=0 out
    while [ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]; do
        attempt=$((attempt + 1))
        log "downloading depot ${depot} manifest ${manifest} (attempt ${attempt}/3)"
        out=$("${STEAMCMD_DIR}/steamcmd.sh" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 0 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 \
              +login anonymous +download_depot 740 "${depot}" "${manifest}" +quit 2>&1)
        echo "${out}" | tail -n 20
        if echo "${out}" | grep -q "Depot download complete"; then
            return 0
        fi
        log "depot ${depot} download did not complete, retrying in 15s"
        sleep 15
    done
    return 1
}

for pair in "731:${MANIFEST_731}" "740:${MANIFEST_740}"; do
    depot="${pair%%:*}"; manifest="${pair##*:}"
    download_depot "${depot}" "${manifest}" || fail "depot ${depot} failed after 3 attempts"
done

DEPOT_731_DIR="${CONTENT_DIR}/depot_731"
DEPOT_740_DIR="${CONTENT_DIR}/depot_740"
[ -d "${DEPOT_731_DIR}" ] || DEPOT_731_DIR="$(find "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" "${HOME:-/root}" -type d -name depot_731 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
[ -d "${DEPOT_740_DIR}" ] || DEPOT_740_DIR="$(find "${STEAMCMD_DIR}" "${HOME:-/root}" -type d -name depot_740 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
[ -n "${DEPOT_731_DIR}" ] && [ -d "${DEPOT_731_DIR}" ] || fail "cannot find the downloaded depot_731 directory"
[ -n "${DEPOT_740_DIR}" ] && [ -d "${DEPOT_740_DIR}" ] || fail "cannot find the downloaded depot_740 directory"

# --- merge the two depots into the server root ------------------------------
# 731 (game content) first, then 740 (server binaries) on top of it. The
# staging copy sits on the same filesystem, so hardlink the files across
# rather than duplicating the whole build; fall back to a real copy if the
# filesystem refuses.
merge_depot() {
    local src="$1"
    log "merging $(basename "${src}") into ${SERVER_DIR}"
    cp -alf "${src}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/" 2>/dev/null \
        || cp -af "${src}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/" \
        || fail "merge of ${src} failed"
}
merge_depot "${DEPOT_731_DIR}"
merge_depot "${DEPOT_740_DIR}"

# --- fixups -----------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg"

for exe in srcds_linux srcds_run; do
    [ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/${exe}" ] && chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/${exe}"
done
find "${SERVER_DIR}/bin" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.so*' -exec chmod 0644 {} \; 2>/dev/null

# The libgcc shipped with 2018-era builds conflicts with modern glibc and makes
# srcds_linux segfault on start. The container's own copy is used instead.
if [ "${STRIP_LIBGCC}" = "true" ] && [ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1" ]; then
    mv -f "${SERVER_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin/libgcc_s.so.1.disabled"
    log "moved bundled bin/libgcc_s.so.1 aside"
fi

# srcds looks for steamclient.so under $HOME/.steam/sdk32, and $HOME is
# /home/container at runtime - which is this directory. Prefer the copy that
# shipped with the 2018 build over SteamCMD's newer one.
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk32"
if [ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/bin/steamclient.so" ]; then
    cp -f "${SERVER_DIR}/bin/steamclient.so" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
    log "staged steamclient.so from the 2018 build"
elif [ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]; then
    cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
    log "staged steamclient.so from SteamCMD"
else
    log "WARNING: no steamclient.so found; the server will run insecure"
fi

if [ -n "${STEAMINF_APPID}" ] && [ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/steam.inf" ]; then
    sed -i "s/^[[:space:]]*appID=.*$/appID=${STEAMINF_APPID}/" "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/steam.inf"
    log "steam.inf appID set to ${STEAMINF_APPID}"
fi

# The file-based equivalent of AMP's SteamAppId=730 environment variable.
echo "730" > "${SERVER_DIR}/steam_appid.txt"

# --- default configs (never overwritten once they exist) --------------------
if [ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/server.cfg" ]; then
    log "writing a default csgo/cfg/server.cfg"
    cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/server.cfg" <<'CFGEOF'
// Edit this file freely - the panel never rewrites it after the install.
//
// hostname, rcon_password, sv_password, sv_lan, sv_region, sv_pure, mapgroup
// and the starting map / game mode are passed on the command line from the
// egg's variables, so setting them here as well overrides what the panel sends.

sv_steamgroup ""
sv_visiblemaxplayers -1
sv_pure_kick_clients 1
sv_consistency 1
sv_cheats 0
sv_allowdownload 1
sv_downloadurl ""
sv_allowupload 1
sv_minrate 80000
sv_maxrate 0
sv_minupdaterate 64
sv_maxupdaterate 128
sv_forcepreload 0
sv_pausable 0
sv_allow_wait_command 0
sv_voiceenable 1
sv_talk_enemy_living 0
sv_talk_enemy_dead 0
sv_clearhinthistory 1
mp_friendlyfire 0
mp_autoteambalance 1
mp_timelimit 0
mp_maxrounds 30
mp_forcecamera 1
mp_disable_autokick 1
tv_autorecord 0
tv_maxclients 10
tv_maxrate 0
exec banned_ip.cfg
exec banned_user.cfg
writeid
writeip
CFGEOF
fi
[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/banned_ip.cfg" ]   || : > "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/banned_ip.cfg"
[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/banned_user.cfg" ] || : > "${SERVER_DIR}/csgo/cfg/banned_user.cfg"

# --- clean up ---------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${KEEP_CACHE}" != "true" ]; then
    log "removing the SteamCMD staging copy to reclaim disk space"
    rm -rf "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
fi

[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/srcds_run" ]   || fail "srcds_run is missing from ${SERVER_DIR}"
[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/srcds_linux" ] || fail "srcds_linux is missing from ${SERVER_DIR}"
log "build ready: 731=${MANIFEST_731} 740=${MANIFEST_740}"

variables.name: Depot 731 Manifest ID
variables.description: Manifest ID for depot 731 (CS:GO game content). Pins the content half of the build. Changing this requires a reinstall.

variables.name: Depot 740 Manifest ID
variables.description: Manifest ID for depot 740 (Linux dedicated server binaries). Pins the binary half of the build. Changing this requires a reinstall.

variables.name: Keep Depot Staging Copy
variables.description: Keep the SteamCMD download under .steamcmd/ after the install. Roughly doubles the disk footprint; only useful when debugging a failed install.

variables.name: Disable Bundled libgcc
variables.description: Move bin/libgcc_s.so.1 aside so the container's own copy is used. The 2018 build ships a libgcc that segfaults against modern glibc, so leave this on unless you know otherwise.

variables.name: steam.inf App ID Override
variables.description: Rewrite appID in csgo/steam.inf after the install. Leave blank to keep the value the build shipped with. 730 = CS:GO, 4465480 = the legacy CS:GO branch app.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Server hostname shown in the browser.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console access. Leave blank to disable RCON.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave blank for a public server.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Steam game server account token from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. Required for a server that should be publicly listed.

variables.name: Steam Web API Key
variables.description: Steam Web API key from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, used for workshop map downloads.

variables.name: Game Directory
variables.description: Mod directory passed to -game. Leave as csgo unless you are running a total conversion.

variables.name: Initial Map
variables.description: Map the server loads on start, e.g. de_dust2, de_mirage, cs_office, dz_blacksite.

variables.name: Map Group
variables.description: Map cycle group from gamemodes_server.txt, e.g. mg_active, mg_casualsigma, mg_armsrace.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: game_type / game_mode pair. Competitive: "+game_type 0 +game_mode 1". Casual: "+game_type 0 +game_mode 0". Wingman: "+game_type 0 +game_mode 2". Arms Race: "+game_type 1 +game_mode 0". Demolition: "+game_type 1 +game_mode 1". Deathmatch: "+game_type 1 +game_mode 2". Danger Zone: "+game_type 6 +game_mode 0".

variables.name: Game Mode Flags
variables.description: sv_game_mode_flags bitfield. 0 = none, 4 = weapons on the ground stay, 32 = enable the Danger Zone HUD, 36 = both.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Player slots, passed as -maxplayers_override.

variables.name: Server Tickrate
variables.description: Server tickrate. 64 matches official matchmaking, 128 matches third-party leagues.

variables.name: LAN Server
variables.description: sv_lan. 1 keeps the server off the master list and off the internet, 0 makes it public.

variables.name: Server Region
variables.description: sv_region. 0 US East, 1 US West, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Asia, 5 Australia, 6 Middle East, 7 Africa, 255 World, -1 unlisted.

variables.name: Pure Server Mode
variables.description: sv_pure. -1 disabled, 0 off, 1 enforce the whitelist, 2 enforce everything.

variables.name: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
variables.description: Set to -insecure to run without VAC, leave blank to keep VAC on. An insecure server cannot be listed publicly.

variables.name: Disable SourceTV
variables.description: Set to -nohltv to turn SourceTV off entirely, leave blank to keep it available.

variables.name: SourceTV Port
variables.description: Port SourceTV binds to. Must be a port allocated to this server and different from the game port.

variables.name: Additional Command Line Parameters
variables.description: Extra arguments appended to the srcds command line, e.g. -threads 4.

variables.name: Additional Console Variables
variables.description: Extra +convar arguments appended after the game mode, e.g. +sv_hibernate_when_empty 0.
